responsibility: Defines the 64-bit PA register file model used by the backend when targeting the PA2.0 wide runtime. It specifies the reduced hard-register numbering scheme, fixed and call-used sets, allocation order, hard-reg width/mode legality, debugger mappings, register classes, argument-passing registers, and assembler register names for the PA64 view where floating-point registers are treated as whole 64-bit registers rather than split halves.
